doc.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Marshal Royal as straw boss and the unnamed white arranger-pianist
summary: Young says Marshal Royal conducted the band and struggles to recall a white California arranger-pianist; a long guessing game over a drummer-led band follows.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Now you said that Count Basie was the artistic director of the band but he had somebody else, he hired somebody else to take care of other things in the band? You said that about Count Basie?
Count Basie did what?
He hired someone else to help lead the band, maybe not artistically, but maybe like a…you said there was somebody else who helped Count Basie run the band?
No, Marshall Royal used to conduct the band a lot.
So he was the straw boss for the Basie band?
Yeah, he used to conduct the band a lot. And there was another guy that used to, he was a white guy, he used to write arrangements and things, he used to conduct…
Could that be Heal Hefti?
No, not Neal Hefti. This guy is dead now, he used to write, he was a big guy— played piano. Oh, what‘s his name? Oh man…
So he was like the staff arranger for the Basie band?
Yeah, he used to write arrangements and he even played in Basie‘s when Basie wasn‘t there, a couple times Basie had something to do, and we would play the gig with him, he piano player.
Is it Ernie Wilkins?
Who?
Well, he said a white guy…
Oh, ok. Brown:…so not Ernie Wilkins.
Who?
He said Ernie Wilkins, but you said it was a white guy…
Oh, yeah, a big white guy played, he was from California. He had a band out here at one time…
Billy May?
Who?
Billy May? Billy May?

No, not Billy May. Name another one because you‘re close, it wasn‘t Billy May. And this guy was…he even had a band with…what‘s the drummer‘s name, got a band now, big band now out here, played a lot of Basie stuff?
It‘s a drummer?
Yeah…
Led by a drummer?

Yeah, he‘s a drummer, he‘s…oh, heck. He just lost his wife last year. He‘s very popular, he‘s a drummer, he‘s got the band. He plays a lot of, he plays Basie‘s music…he plays Basie band. I played in the band for a long time, I played in the band for a long time, the band is still going. What‘s the popular band here? Are you from California?
Originally. Well, I‘m trying to think. You…
A drummer. Not too many drummers leading bands these days.
Huh?
I said not too many drummers leading bands these days.
Yeah, it‘s a drummer here, you got to know, you a drummer, you‘ve got to know who this is.
Well the only person I‘m thinking of is, I mean, you‘ve got…
He‘s a…
Because it used to be Mel Lewis…
Who?
Mel Lewis, I know that‘s not the band…
No, not Mel Lewis. Brown:…he‘s gone, he‘s gone now, I know.
Butch Miles?
Butch? Yeah, well Butch played in Basie‘s band. Butch Miles?
Butch Miles, he‘s not white.
Butch Miles is white….
Butch Miles?
Butch Miles is white. He played in Basie‘s band. I think, I don‘t know if he came in after Sonny…
This drummer never played in Basie‘s band.
Oh, ok, so…
He‘s got the band out here now.
Dang. I don‘t know, are we at time? We can take a break and we can research it?
Butch Miles is white, what made me think he wasn‘t it, I remember Butch Miles.
Yeah. Young:…slipped my mind.
Maybe you‘re thinking of Buddy Miles. [laughs] …
